title: HALQA Platform Alert Rules
description: Prometheus-backed alert rules for Grafana. Import via Grafana UI → Alerting → Alert Rules → Import.

annotations.description: The halqa-api process has not exposed metrics for over 1 minute. The service may be down.
annotations.runbook: Restart the backend container: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart backend

annotations.description: More than 5% of requests are returning 5xx errors in the last 5 minutes. Possible DB or upstream failure.
annotations.runbook: Check backend logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs --tail=100 backend

annotations.summary: More than 5 slow DB queries per second
annotations.description: Elevated slow query rate suggests connection pool pressure or missing index. Check SLOW_QUERY_THRESHOLD_MS logs.
annotations.runbook: Run SHOW PROCESSLIST; in MySQL. Check query cache hit rate and index usage.

annotations.description: Redis is responding slowly. Rate limiting and caching may be degraded. App falls back to in-memory.
annotations.runbook: Check Redis container: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs redis

annotations.summary: p95 API response time above 2 seconds
annotations.description: 95th percentile response time has exceeded 2000ms for 5 minutes. Users may be experiencing slowness.
annotations.runbook: Check DB slow query log and Redis latency metrics.

annotations.description: Unusually high number of active WebSocket connections. Check for connection leaks or viral traffic spike.
annotations.runbook: Check voice room participant counts and verify socket disconnect handlers are firing.

annotations.summary: No backup completed in the last 25 hours
annotations.description: The daily backup has not run or failed. Data loss risk is elevated.
annotations.runbook: Check db-backup container logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs db-backup. Run manually: docker exec halqa-backup sh /backup/backup.sh
